task_completion.description: Open the human_insulin_gene.gb file in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE sequence viewer window is open showing the human insulin gene sequence or its annotations (e.g., CDS, exon).

task_completion.description: Perform a restriction site analysis using the 'Analyze -> Find restriction sites' tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Restriction Analysis' dialog box is visible, or the 'Restriction Sites' track appears in the sequence view.

task_completion.description: Annotate the sequence with the identified restriction enzyme recognition sites.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sequence map shows multiple new enzyme labels (e.g., EcoRI, BamHI, etc.) as annotations or features on the sequence.

task_completion.description: Save the annotated sequence to the specified path: ~/UGENE_Data/results/insulin_restriction_annotated.gb.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' or 'Export' dialog shows the file path /home/ga/UGENE_Data/results/insulin_restriction_annotated.gb being entered or confirmed.

task_completion.description: Compare restriction sites against the CDS boundaries to identify internal vs. external cutters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen highlighting the CDS region and checking which enzyme sites fall inside or outside that specific range.

task_completion.description: Generate the cloning strategy report with the required lists and recommended enzyme pair.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or UGENE note is open showing the 'cloning_strategy_report.txt' containing a total enzyme count, internal cutters, external cutters, and a recommended pair.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE graphical interface rather than just command-line scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and dialog boxes being interacted with by the cursor.

integrity.description: The restriction sites were generated by the software, not manually typed into a report from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Restriction Sites' track in UGENE is populated with data that matches the final report content.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific 'results' subdirectory as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file explorer or save dialog confirms the path includes 'UGENE_Data/results/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input file is NM_000207.3 (human insulin). The CDS typically spans from approximately position 60 to 400 (depending on the specific GenBank version). The agent must identify at least 10 enzyme annotations. The report must be saved at ~/UGENE_Data/results/cloning_strategy_report.txt and must explicitly name a pair of two different enzymes for directional cloning (e.g., enzymes that flank the CDS but do not cut within it).
